personality_one_liner: Trustworthy, structured, and clear; an iOS-native facility management tool that feels snappy, highly readable, and perfectly balanced for on-the-go school staff.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical padding, use safe area context at screen roots. Cards and buttons should have minimum 44pt touch targets.

do's: Use glassmorphism (expo-blur) on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers above scrollable content.
Use glass on Bottom Sheet headers/handles.
dont's: Never apply glass to the interactive floor plan room pins or task cards.
Never blur body text regions or chat bubbles.

screens.name: Auth / Role Picker
screens.purpose: Select user role (Cleaner, Teacher, Boss, Admin) and authenticate.

states.error: Standard iOS style alert for invalid credentials.

screens.layout: Vertical stack. Top 1/3: Gobigred branding (Husker red logo or text). Middle: 4 large, full-width `surfaceSecondary` cards acting as role buttons. Clicking a role opens an `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` for entry: Cleaner/Teacher (Text input for Name), Boss (Name + Password), Admin (Password 'Gobigred' only).

screens.name: Floor Plan (Main Dashboard)
screens.purpose: Interactive map of the building showing real-time room statuses.

states.loading: Skeleton overlay on top of the blueprint background.
states.error: Error banner with 'Retry' button to fetch layout.

screens.layout: Sticky top header with Building Dropdown (glass effect). The main canvas is an `expo-image` of a blueprint wrapped in a horizontal/vertical ScrollView or PanGestureHandler for panning. Rooms/Stairs/Hallways are rendered as absolutely positioned pill-shaped `Pressable`s over the blueprint. Pills use background colors tied to status: Gray (Untouched), Red (Teacher in), Yellow (In Progress), Green (Completed). Admin profile sees an 'Edit Mode' FAB to reposition/rename pills.

screens.name: Room Detail (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: Shows memos, photos, and tasks for a selected room from the Floor Plan.
screens.layout: Triggered via tapping a room pill. Uses `@gorhom/bottom-sheet`. Header: Room Name and Status pill. Content: Horizontal ScrollView for room photos, followed by a 'Memos' section (Teacher/Admin notes), and a vertical list of Task cards. Cleaners can tap tasks to complete them (Boss sees Redo option).

screens.name: Numbers Page
screens.purpose: Metrics dashboard tracking school start countdown and cleaning progress.
screens.layout: Scrollable vertical list. Top Hero Card: Large typography 'Countdown to School Start' with `brandPrimary` text. Below: A 2-column grid of building progress cards. Each card contains the building name, a percentage, and a horizontal progress bar (filled with Green for completed rooms).

screens.name: Chat & DMs
screens.purpose: Messaging hub for Cleaners and Boss.

states.empty: Illustration 'No messages yet' with CTA 'Start a Chat'.

screens.layout: Standard iOS-style chat list (Avatars/Initials + Name + Preview). Inside a chat: Apple Messages style bubbles (`surfaceTertiary` for received, `brandPrimary` for sent). Boss can send 'Tasks' within chat which render as special interactive cards within the message flow.

screens.name: Photo Contest
screens.purpose: Weekly social feed for Cleaners and Boss to submit photos and vote.

states.empty: Empty state illustration: 'Be the first to submit a photo!'

screens.layout: Instagram-style vertical feed. Each item: Submitter info header, large full-width image (with top-to-bottom gradient scrim if text overlays), and a row of action buttons (Upvote). Cleaners and Boss see a sticky FAB at the bottom to 'Submit Photo'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load custom fonts 'Geist' locally via expo-font. Do not use @expo-google-fonts.

Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). The Bottom Tabs change based on role. Cleaners: Floor Plan, Chat, Photo Contest. Teachers: Floor Plan, Numbers. Boss: Floor Plan, Numbers, Chat, Photo Contest. Admin: Floor Plan (with Edit Mode), Numbers.

Floor Plan UI: Render the `floor_plan_blueprint` image as a background canvas inside a pan/zoom wrapper. Rooms are absolutely positioned buttons on top of it. Ensure you bind the 4 specific status colors (untouched=gray, teacher_in=red, in_progress=yellow, completed=green) directly to these pins.
The 'Teacher in' status uses `status_teacher_in` (#FF3B30). This is distinct from the brand primary #E41C38. Ensure teachers can tap their room to toggle this status.
For the Room Detail bottom sheet, stack room photos horizontally, followed by text memos, then a list of checkable tasks.
For the Numbers page, the countdown should be massive and highly legible, acting as the hero element.

Admin Edit Mode for Floor Plan: When the Admin signs in, they can toggle an 'Edit' state allowing them to drag and drop room pins, rename them, and resize them. Save these updated X/Y coordinates to state.
Always apply a dark gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) behind text when overlaying on images (like the Photo Contest feed).
